pinev: Village-level: the 1909 reports place the house at Garden, Delta Co; house not located (about 1.5 km).

1900 census: a single German-born farmer of this name owning his farm, living alone, in Sack Bay Twp (Garden peninsula). Michigan death record: died 3 Feb 1909 in Fairbanks Twp, Delta Co. Farm not on a plat, so the pin stays at Garden.

src: US census 1900 Sack Bay Twp, Delta Co MI, ED 45 sheet 6B; Michigan death record 3 Feb 1909, Fairbanks Twp (Ancestry, PC (b))

pinev: The only Ole Johnson/Johnsen land patent in the townships around Carney: state patent 20 Mar 1885, NW1/4 NE1/4 + NE1/4 NW1/4 sec 30 T37N R26W (80 acres), about 1 km S of Carney (BLM PLSS). A name match only. A common name, and the 1912 atlas no longer shows him, so pin confidence is D.
1900 census: a Swedish-born farmer of this name, owning his farm free of mortgage, listed in Nadeau Twp next to Carney village; consistent with the 1885 patent 80 but not proven.

src: US census 1900 Nadeau Twp / Carney, Menominee Co MI, ED 148 sheet 1A (Ancestry, PC (b))
